etsy.title: Hockey Legend Poster, Certified Puck Slapper Print, Funny Wall Art, Ice Rink Gift
etsy.description:
A hockey legend poster for the self-proclaimed certified puck slapper, featuring crossed sticks and bold typography.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a man cave, garage, game room, or office.

This listing is a physical poster print. Generic design: no league, team, or club marks. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Hockey legend-themed products on Etsy are mostly team-specific or player-specific; generic legend prints are rare.
Most physical hockey posters on Etsy are personalized jersey prints or vintage rink art.
Amazon hockey legend products are mostly about specific pro players; generic legend wall art is uncommon.
Funny hockey wall decor on Amazon is mostly small tin signs and metal signs.

research.notes: Hockey legend as a phrase is mostly associated with specific pro players. This poster uses it humorously for rec-league self-identification, which is an underserved angle.
